For an exact scalar angle on a source with a proved represented radial displacement, evaluate the center in its original joint field and reuse that represented unit normal through the existing chord-normal circle carrier. endpoint_tangent_contract: Extend the existing exact represented endpoint tangent to every exact scalar angular parameter using the original rational half-chart and shared represented-unit-normal authority, including chord-normal frames. chord_point_equality_contract: For a procedural chord displacement with certified represented unit tangent and a joint-field or lazy/similarity counterpart, consume the existing source-bound coordinate proof before interval refinement. circle_pair_exclusion_contract: The shared point-field predicate signs 4*q*r1²-(q+r1²-r2²)², q=|C2-C1|², with original nonzero coordinate guards and a cleared squared denominator. A strict negative value proves no real support contact and therefore no selected-arc contact. Zero/positive/unsupported cases retain existing intersection authority; actual resource exhaustion propagates. This is not a claim of general intersecting-circle or arbitrary implicit support.

This finite direction count is not a total work/memory budget.
